accepted_claims: The existing RCS-011 native evidence demonstrates bounded conventional advanced-B-rep/STEP write-and-fresh-read feasibility for 32 successful exact-strategy attempts, while its valid-but-materially-wrong counterexample proves B-rep validity alone is not material correctness.

Public STEP schema/resource definitions provide structural conventional routes for regular manifold solids, enclosed disjoint void shells and multiple manifold-solid representation items; these are structural source facts, not consumer qualification.
Eight required early obstruction classes are frozen and each has either a qualifying bounded native witness plus strategy or an explicit representability blocker.

Exact-zero contact, positive micro-material, disconnected durable bodies and empty material are non-compensating semantics; tolerance healing, largest-body selection and fake residual solids are forbidden.

The MC-016 verifier pins reviewed dependency/historical evidence sources and rejects missing blockers, premature MC-C promotion, faceted/tessellated primary-output substitution, zero/positive collapse and evidence-class promotion.
open_claims: No qualifying machining-generated native STEP plus independent-consumer witness has yet established BREP_WITH_VOIDS cavity output.
Disconnected multi-solid output is structurally expressible but durable-body/lineage mapping and independent-consumer preservation remain unqualified.
No qualifying native STEP witness demonstrates preservation of the certified positive micro-feature boundary; the historical 1 um external comparator refused resolution-qualified authority.
Exact-zero contacts, touching cavities and singular pinches require an MC-054 profile decision and MC-017 consumer evidence without healing or fusing material.
Empty-material engineering-output semantics and downstream handling remain unqualified.
MC-C, MC-B, MC-D, MC-E, MC-F and MC-1 remain NOT_ESTABLISHED.
adversarial_controls: reject any unwitnessed obstruction class with no explicit blocker
reject largest-body-only or fused multi-solid output
reject faceted/tessellated wrapping as primary engineering success
reject positive micro-material erased by tolerance or sewing
reject exact-zero contact healed into a positive bridge
reject empty material represented by a fake epsilon solid or nonempty placeholder
reject deterministic-model evidence promoted to native geometry
reject drift of pinned dependency and historical evidence blobs

review.disposition: completed early representability research with explicit open blockers; artifact dependents may consume the strategy matrix but no output capability gate is promoted
review.downstream_release: MC-024/025/027/028/029/030 and MC-038 may consume the bounded structural strategies and blockers; MC-017/MC-054 own consumer/profile closure for affected singular/grouped/empty semantics

blockers.summary: No source-bound machining-generated native STEP witness plus independent consumer evidence for BREP_WITH_VOIDS cavity output.
Multi-solid STEP is structurally expressible but durable-body mapping and independent consumer preservation are not natively qualified.
No qualifying native STEP write/read witness demonstrates preservation of a certified positive micro-feature at the MC-1 boundary; historical external comparison refused the 1 um case.
Exact-zero contacts, touching cavities and singular pinches require an explicit MC-054 output-profile decision plus independent-consumer evidence; healing or tolerance fusion is forbidden.
Empty-material engineering-output semantics are not yet qualified; a fake residual solid or placeholder STEP is not acceptable.

downstream_invalidations: a changed STEP/output profile invalidates affected MC-016 route conclusions and requires reviewed MC-054-compatible revision
a defect or semantic change in the pinned historical sources invalidates only conclusions that consumed that source and does not rewrite producing evidence
closing a representability blocker requires source-bound native output and, where recorded, independent-consumer/profile evidence rather than issue closure alone
any later attempt to erase/fuse positive material, bodies, contacts or lineage supersedes the affected output claim rather than weakening the MC-1 denominator
